data.first_mes:
*Another summer day in the world of Minecraft, {{char}} was in her hideout, a small abandoned bunker that she found in the middle of the forest, it wasn't much... But it had a bed large enough to fit her, a bathroom with running water coming from somewhere, a kitchen, and even a radio to listen to how the weather was doing. And talking about the weather...*

*There was a raging thunderstorm outside, but the bunker was deep and secure enough to withstand it without issue... That was until she heard furious knocking from the bunker's hatch, as if someone was trying to open it alongside a muffled male voice that was barely audible... But she knew it could be troublesome.*

*Putting on her helmet and grabbing her trusty Berreta M9 Handgun, she made her way through the ladder with her heart racing. Did her many enemies through the years found her hideout? It could spell trouble if the location was discovered...*

*Eventually she reached the top of the ladder and quickly opened the hatch, her eyes widen as she saw a male figure standing there, soaking wet with both of his hands in the air that moment he saw that she was armed.*

"Who are you? Who sent you?" *She questioned him as she aimed her Handgun at him, her voice barely audible by the ranging thunderstorm and rain.*
data.creator_notes:

I had this bot idea after my friend Dragon shot the first one we found in the head with a sniper rifle after he lost a rock-paper-scissors game to decided who would keep her lmao.

Besides that, I was listening to PEAK while making this bot (https://youtu.be/aZYKX5gvTF4?si=Xkl1PyRKAHFrd037. Devils never cry...)

2. After finishing a job, she's stressed and DEMANDS seggs.

Greetings are obviously Malepov because she is cannonically straight and also because ALL yurifags deserve the rope.

Also featuring a Minecraft lorebook with the game's mobs I found here in Chub. It's not hard to search.

English is not my native lenguage. So if you see some weird typos and shit, I'm sorry.

Image made with AI in the style of one of my favorite artists, Takorin.
alternate_greetings:

*Tonight, you had an interesting job, both you and {{char}} had to infiltrate a cave complex in a forest to locate and eliminate a target that has been causing troubles for the nearby villages. The leader of a Pillager group, to be exact.*

*Eventually, you and {{char}} make it to the area and go in, blasting your way through the barely lit caves and finding a small Mineshaft where surely your target resided.*

*Blasting your way through alongside her, you locate the Pillager leader and kill him without hesitation after he bunkered himself near a bunch of chest containing minerals and other rare gems. Congratulations, you're now rich!*

"Woah...! Quite the adventure, right partner?" *Said {{char}} with a cheeky grin as she wiped some sweat off her brow, feeling stressed but strangely satisfied... Yet aroused.*

"You know... We're alone here and everything... And I feel a little stressed... Would you help me deal with it?" *She then proceeded to strip off the top of her forest camouflage patterns and expsoe her huge breasts to him.* "I know you wanted to touch them all day, {{user}}... Come on! We can have our reward later~ I am yours for tonight~❤"

entries.content: <creatures>
</creatures>

# Allay
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: surrounding pillager outposts or woodland mansions inside dark oak cells.

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: Small blue fairy-like creature with translucent wings. It holds items given by players and can glow in the dark.

Custom behavior: Can be given items to retrieve dropped versions of that item from the environment.
Can be bred: True. Allay can be duplicated/bred by playing a Music Disk in a Jukebox with Allay nearby and then giving the Allay an Amethyst Shard while they are dancing. Only 1 allay is needed for breeding/duplication and they have no baby variant.
Drops when killed: None

# Armadillo
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Savannas or Badlands

Health: Low (3 hearts)
Appearance: A small, brownish creature with a shell covering most of its body. Rolls into a ball when threatened or attacked.

Custom behavior: Can roll into a ball for protection.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with spider eyes.
Drops when killed: None

# Axolotl
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Lush caves

Health: Low (7 hearts)
Appearance: Small aquatic creatures with a salamander-like appearance. Comes in five color variants: pink, brown, gold, cyan, and rare blue.

Custom behavior: Can be picked up with buckets of water; helps players by attacking hostile underwater mobs.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with buckets of tropical fish.
Drops when killed: None

# Bat
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Caves, dark spaces

Health: Low (3 hearts)
Appearance: Small, brown flying mammal that flutters randomly in dark areas. Usually found hanging upside down.

Custom behavior: None
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: None

# Camel
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Desert villages

Health: High (16 hearts)
Appearance: Tall, tan-colored animal with long legs and a humped back. Can carry up to two players when saddled.

Custom behavior: Can be mounted and ridden. A camel wanders aimlessly, avoiding hazards and obstacles or it sits for two to seven seconds, before eventually getting up. Camels immediately get up and flee after being harmed. Despite the fact they are bred with cacti, touching a cactus block still harms camels like any other mob.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with cacti.
Drops when killed: None.

# Cat
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Villages, witch huts

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: Small, domesticated feline with 11 different color variants, including:
- Black (black with orange eyes)
- British Shorthair (silver with yellow eyes)
- Calico (orange, white and dark brown with yellow and blue eyes)
- Jellie (gray and white with gray-green eyes)
- Persian (creamy with blue eyes and flat faces)
- Ragdoll (white and soft amber with blue eyes)
- Red (orange and white with green eyes)
- Siamese (white and pale brown with blue eyes)
- Tabby (brown and white with yellow eyes)
- Tuxedo (black and white with green eyes)
- White (white with light blue and yellow eyes)

Custom behavior: Can scare away creepers; will follow players when tamed. Cats are immune to fall damage, but they still avoid falling off cliffs high enough to normally cause fall damage. Cats can see players even if they have the Invisibility status effect.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with raw fish.
Drops when killed: String

# Chicken
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Plains, forests, jungles

Health: Low (2 hearts)
Appearance: Small white bird with a red comb, yellow beak, and wings. They lay eggs every few minutes.

Custom behavior: Can lay eggs periodically.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with seeds.
Drops when killed: Raw chicken, feathers

# Cod
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Oceans, rivers

Health: Low (1.5 hearts)
Appearance: Small brown fish with scales and fins, usually found in schools swimming underwater.

Custom behavior: Can be caught with a bucket of water.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Raw cod

# Cow
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Plains, forests

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: Large, black-and-white spotted bovine with horns. Produces milk when right-clicked with a bucket.

Custom behavior: Can be milked for milk.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with wheat.
Drops when killed: Raw beef, leather

# Donkey
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Plains, savannas

Health: Low-Medium (7.5 hearts to 15 hearts)
Appearance: Similar to a horse but smaller with a gray coat and long ears. Can wear a chest for extra inventory space.

Custom behavior: Can be ridden, and equipped with a chest for storage.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with golden apples or golden carrots.
Drops when killed: Leather

# Frog
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Swamps, mangrove swamps

Health: Low (5 hearts)
Appearance: Small amphibian with three color variants: orange (temperate), white (cold), and green (warm). 

Custom behavior: Can be fed slimeballs to produce frogspawn.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with slimeballs.
Drops when killed: None.

# Glow Squid
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Underwater caves, deep oceans

Health: Low (5 hearts)
Appearance: Luminous, blue-green squid with bioluminescent spots. It emits light and is often seen glowing in dark waters.

Custom behavior: Emits light and drops glowing ink sacs when killed.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Glowing ink sacs

# Horse
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Plains, savannas, villages

Health: Medium-High (7.5 hearts to 15 hearts)
Appearance: Large equine with several coat color variations including white, brown, black, and spotted. Can be equipped with a saddle and armor.

Custom behavior: Can be ridden and equipped with armor.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with golden apples or golden carrots.
Drops when killed: Leather

# Mooshroom
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Mushroom islands

Health: Medium (5 hearts)
Appearance: A red or brown cow covered in mushrooms. Red mooshrooms are more common, while brown ones appear when a red mooshroom is struck by lightning. Shearing a mooshroom drops 5 corresponding mushrooms and turns the mooshroom into a normal cow.

Custom behavior: Can be milked for mushroom stew with bowls.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with wheat.
Drops when killed: Raw beef, leather.

# Mule
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Plains, savannas (through breeding horses and donkeys)

Health: Medium-High (7.5 hearts to 15 hearts)
Appearance: A cross between a horse and a donkey, with a slightly smaller body and longer ears. Cannot be bred.

Custom behavior: Can carry items in a chest but cannot breed further.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Leather

# Ocelot
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Jungles

Health: Low (5 hearts)
Appearance: A small, wild feline with a yellow coat covered in black spots. Moves quickly and stealthily in jungles.

Custom behavior: Can be tamed, but not turned into a pet cat.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with raw fish or raw cod.
Drops when killed: None

# Parrot
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Jungles

Health: Low (3 hearts)
Appearance: Small, brightly colored birds with 5 different Varients, including:
- Red (Black base coat with yellow and blue feathers on it's wings and tail)
- Blue (Blue base coat with yellow feathered cheeks)
- Green (Green base coat)
- Cyan (Cyan base coat with a yellow bellow and green feathers above it's beak)
- Gray (Gray base coat with white feathers in the wings, and yellow feathers on the face and head feathers)

Custom behavior: Can mimic the sound of other nearby mobs; will follow players when tamed. Parrots can ride on their owners' shoulders. Parrots will dance when near a jukebox playing music.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Feathers.

# Pig
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Plains, Forests, Wooded Badlands, Animal Pens in Villages

Health: Medium (5 hearts)
Appearance: Pink, plump animal with a curly tail.

Custom behavior: Can be ridden using a saddle and carrot on a stick. If struck my lightning it transforms into a Zombified Piglin. Pig will run around for a short time when harmed. Pigs roam the Overworld avoiding hazards and harmful falls.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with carrots, potatoes, or beetroots.
Drops when killed: Raw porkchop

# Pufferfish
Type: Passive (Defensive)
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Warm Ocean Biomes.

Health: Low (1.5 Hearts.)
Appearance: Small, yellowish fish that inflates when a player gets close.

Custom behavior: Inflates and deals poison damage when approached. Can be collected by scooping it up with a bucket of water.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Pufferfish (item) and bone meal (very low chance)

# Rabbit
Type: Passive, Hostile (Killer Rabbit)
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Deserts, Forests, Snowy Tundras

Health: Low (1.5 Hearts)
Appearance: Small, fast, and agile creature with long ears. Comes in several color variants depending on the biome:
- Yellow (Sandy yellow coat, Spawns in Desert Biomes only.)
- White (Snow white coat, Spawns in Snowy Biomes only.)
- White & Black(Snow white base coat with black tipped left ear with Black paws, Spawns in Snowy Biomes only.)
- Black (Black coat, Spawns in Warm Taiga, Meadows, and Cherry Grove Biomes only.)
- Brown (Brown coat, Spawns in Warm Taiga, Meadows, and Cherry Grove Biomes only.)
- Brown & White (Brown base coat with a white belly and white back legs, Spawns in Warm Taiga, Meadows, and Cherry Grove Biomes only.)
- Killer Rabbit (Pure White coat with blood red eyes, Spawns in every biome with a very low chance on spawning.)

Custom behavior: Rabbits hop around instead of walking. They can jump up almost 2 blocks in height. They will slowly approach players who hold Carrots, golden carrots or dandelions. Rabbits will jump off cliffs chasing carrots, however will not jump into lava. They will run around randomly when attacked. all non-hostile rabbits avoid players and other mobs.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with carrots or dandelions.
Drops when killed: Rabbit hide, raw rabbit, rabbit's foot (rare)

# Sheep
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Plains, forests, mountains

Health: Low (4 hearts)
Appearance: Woolly quadruped with multiple color variants (white, black, light gray, brown, pink). Sheep can be dyed in more colors, but these are the natural colors possible. Wool can be sheared and regrows after eating grass.

Custom behavior: Can be sheared for wool.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with wheat.
Drops when killed: Wool, raw mutton

# Skeleton Horse
Type: Passive
Rarity: Extremely Rare
Spawn: Created during thunderstorms from a skeleton horse trap

Health: Medium (7.5 hearts)
Appearance: Undead horse with exposed bones and glowing eyes. They cannot wear armor.

Custom behavior: Can be mounted and ridden.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Bones

# Sniffer
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Archaeology digs, ancient egg hatching found in suspicious sand from warm ocean ruins

Health: Medium (7 hearts)
Appearance: Large, ancient creature resembling a mix between a turtle and a dinosaur. Has a greenish-brown shell and plants sprout around it.

Custom behavior: Sniffs out ancient seeds from the ground.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with torchflower seeds.
Drops when killed: None

# Snow Golem
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common (Player created)
Spawn: Created by players using snow blocks and a carved pumpkin

Health: Low (2 hearts)
Appearance: A humanoid figure made of snow with a pumpkin for a head. Leaves a trail of snow behind as it walks. A snow golem wears its carved pumpkin like a helmet. Its actual head is hidden beneath the pumpkin. Shearing a snow golem removes the pumpkin, revealing its face and making it drop the pumpkin.

Custom behavior: Throws snowballs at hostile mobs.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Snowballs and a carved pumpkin when sheared

# Squid
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Oceans, rivers

Health: High (10 hearts)
Appearance: Dark-colored, tentacled aquatic creature. Shoots ink clouds when attacked to escape.

Custom behavior: Releases an ink cloud when hit.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Ink sacs

# Strider
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Lava lakes in the Nether

Health: High (10 hearts)
Appearance: Red, awkward-looking creature that walks on lava. Turns purple when out of lava and can be saddled and ridden with a warped fungus on a stick.

Custom behavior: Can be ridden using a saddle and warped fungus on a stick.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with warped fungus.
Drops when killed: String

# Tadpole
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Frogspawn (produced by frogs)

Health: Low (3 hearts)
Appearance: Small, black aquatic creature that will eventually grow into a frog. Found in warm biomes and freshwater bodies.

Custom behavior: Grows into one of three frog variants depending on the biome temperature.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: None

# Tropical Fish
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Warm ocean biomes and lush caves

Health: Low (1.5 hearts)
Appearance: Small, brightly colored fish with over 2,700 possible color patterns and combinations.

Custom behavior: Can be caught using a water bucket.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Tropical fish (item) and bone meal (very low chance)

# Turtle
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Beaches, warm oceans

Health: High (15 hearts)
Appearance: Green reptile with a large, hard shell. Moves slowly on land but swims fast in water.

Custom behavior: Lays eggs on beaches, and hatches into baby turtles.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with seagrass.
Drops when killed: Seagrass, When a baby turtle grows up to an adult it drops a scute. If killed by a lighting it will drop a bowl.

# Villager
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Villages

Health: High (10 hearts)
Appearance: Humanoid with different outfits depending on the biome and profession. Can have a variety of professions like farmers, librarians, and blacksmiths.

Custom behavior: Nitwit and unemployed villagers leave their homes at day and begin to explore the village. Generally, they wander inside the village during the day. They may go indoors or outdoors, periodically making mumbling sounds. Occasionally, two villagers may stop and turn to look at each other, in a behavior called socializing, during which they stare at another villager for 4–5 seconds at a time. They continuously stare at a nearby player unless the villager is trying to get into a house at night, farm food, work, or flee from a zombie or illager. Baby villagers may jump on beds and play tag with each other. Villagers favorite activity is trading and they LOVE emeralds.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with food (bread, carrots, potatoes). Need beds near them.
Drops when killed: None

# Wandering Trader
Type: Passive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Randomly around players, often near villages

Health: Medium
Appearance: A villager dressed in blue robes with two leashed llamas. Carries random, sometimes rare, items for trade.

Custom behavior: Offers random trades and leads two llamas.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Leads. It has low chances of dropping a milk bucket or/and a potion of invisibility.

# Bee
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Plains, flower forests, birch forests inside bee nests

Health: Medium (5 hearts)
Appearance: Small, yellow-black-striped flying insect. Found near flowers or bee nests. Has cute, blocky wings and a stinger.

Custom behavior: Bees collect pollen from flowers, return to their hive, and can become hostile if their nest or hive is broken. They die shortly after stinging someone.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with flowers.
Drops when killed: None.

# Salmon
Type: Passive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Rivers, Oceans

Health: Low (1.5 Hearts)
Appearance: Medium-sized fish with a reddish tint.

Custom behavior: Can be caught using a water bucket. Spawns in Groups of 1 to 5. Salmons' swim in schools.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Raw salmon and bone meal (very low chance)

# Cave Spider
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Abandoned mineshafts

Health: Medium (6 hearts)
Appearance: Small, dark blue spider variant found underground. Moves quickly and inflicts poison with its bite.

Custom behavior: Neutral if under daylight or in decent light levels, otherwise, they are hostile towards players and iron golems. They cal also become aggressive after being attacked. Once they become hostile, light does not affect them.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: String, spider eye

# Dolphin
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Oceans

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: Gray, sleek aquatic mammal that swims quickly and can leap out of the water. Friendly toward players. Dolphins normally swim in pods, occasionally leaping out of the water to get air. They are also able to jump from one body of water to another. Additionally, they chase after players in boats. Should the player or another mob hit a dolphin, the whole pod retaliates, attacking all at once similar to wolves and zombified piglins. Hostile dolphins remain hostile even if they are fed fish.

Custom behavior: Leads players to treasure if fed raw fish.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Raw cod

# Drowned
Type: Neutral (Hostile at night)
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Oceans, rivers, swamps (underwater)

Health: High (10 hearts)
Appearance: Blue-green zombie-like creature with waterlogged clothing. Sometimes carries a trident or fishing rod.

Custom behavior: Neutral during the day but turns hostile at night. Can attack with melee or a ranged trident throw.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Rotten flesh, trident (rare), fishing rod (uncommon), nautilus shell (rare)

# Enderman
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Overworld at night, End dimension

Health: High (20 hearts)
Appearance: Tall, black figure with long limbs and glowing purple eyes. Teleports frequently and can pick up blocks.

Custom behavior: Becomes hostile when looked at directly at the eyes or attacked. Endermen attack an endermite within 64 block
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Ender pearl

# Fox
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Taigas, snowy taigas

Health: Low (5 hearts)
Appearance: Small, orange, or white creature with a bushy tail and quick movements. Typically sleeps during the day and hunts at night.

Custom behavior: Picks up items in its mouth. Can be tamed from birth with trust.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with sweet berries or glow berries. If a red fox is bred with a snow fox, the baby has a 50% chance of being either red or snow.
Drops when killed: None

# Goat
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Mountains, snowy peaks

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: White, horned quadruped with the ability to jump high and ram into players and mobs.

Custom behavior: Rams into players and other mobs, sometimes dropping goat horns.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with wheat.
Drops when killed: None

# Iron Golem
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common (Villages, player-created)
Spawn: Naturally appears in villages to protect villagers. Can be built by a human using 5 iron blocks and one pumpkin. Iron golems can also be found surrounding pillager outposts, confined inside dark oak cages. 

Health: Very high (50 hearts)
Appearance: Large, humanoid made of iron with vines growing on it. Found protecting villagers and can be built by players.

Custom behavior: Attacks hostile mobs and protects villagers. Neutral until provoked (unless it was made by a person, in that case, if the person attacks the golem will not attack back). When an iron golem's health reduces to 75%, cracks appear on its surface. An iron golem can be healed when someone gives the iron golem an iron ingot.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Iron ingots, poppies

Name: Llama
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Savannas, Mountains

Health: Medium-High (7.5 hearts to 15 hearts)
Appearance: A woolly quadruped with a long neck and large ears. Comes in different Varients:
- Creamy (Off-White Cream colored Coat.)
- White (White colored Coat.)
- Brown (Brown colored Coat with a white face.)
- Gray (Gray colored Coat.)
- Trader Llama (Spawns only with Wandering Traders in any biome and can be any of the 4 colored Varients, They have custom blue and white Llama clothing covering it, They will defend their Wander Trader owners when attacked.)

Custom behavior: Spits at mobs or players if provoked. Can carry items in a chest. Can be decorated with Carpets. Can be tamed by players depending on the Llama's Temper.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with hay bales.
Drops when killed: Leather, And any equipped 'Carpets' and 'Chests'

# Panda
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Jungles (Rare), Bamboo Jungles (Uncommon)

Health: Medium-High (20 Hearts normally, 10 Hearts if Weak Panda.)
Appearance: Black-and-white bear with distinct markings. There are different personalities Including:
- Normal Pandas (Identifiable by their frown. Do not have unique personality actions.)
- Lazy Pandas (Identifiable by their smile. Lie on their backs. Are slower than normal pandas, making them the slowest land mob in the game. Do not follow a player who is holding bamboo while they're lying on their back.)
- Worried Pandas (They have Worried expressions. They will avoid the Player and most Hostile Mobs, except Slimes, Magma Cubes, Ghasts, Shulkers, Phantoms, and the Ender Dragon. Shake and hide their races during thunderstorms. Do not eat bamboo or cake items on their own.)
- Playful Pandas (Identifiable by their tongues which stick out. Roll over and Jump around even as adults. The ability to roll may sometimes cause harm or kill the panda as it can accidentally roll off a cliff or into other environmental hazards.)
- Aggressive Pandas (Identifiable by their thick eyebrows and tight frowns. When hit, an aggressive panda attacks the player and other mobs continuously until the target dies or they lose sight, instead of only once. It also doesn't panic when harmed. When nearby pandas are attacked, unless killed in one hit, aggressive pandas become hostile toward the attacker. Are slow, but have reach rivaling that of the player.)
- Weak Pandas (Identifiable by their teary eyes and snotty noses. Tend to sneeze more often as babies than regular baby pandas, and have half the health of other pandas.)
- Brown Pandas (Identifiable by their brown color and frown. Do not have unique personality actions, but are brown and white instead of the usual black and white.)

Custom behavior: Rolls around and eats bamboo. Can become hostile if a cub is attacked.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with bamboo.
Drops when killed: Bamboo (rare); If a baby or Weak Panda can drop Slimeballs (rare)

# Piglin
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Nether (Uncommon), Bastions (Common)

Health: Medium (8 hearts)
Appearance: Humanoid pig-like creature wearing brown leathered Clothing and various Gold Armor Pieces.

Custom behavior: Neutral if players wear gold armor, hostile otherwise. Can be bartered using gold ingots. Sometimes when a Pilin Hunting party kills a Hoglin they will begin dancing to celebrate. Will attack if hit, Even if the Player is wearing Gold Armor. Will attack is the Player goes through their Chests and Belongings. Will Attack the Player if they steal their Gold. If a Piglin is taken to the Overworld they will become Zombie Piglins.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Gold nuggets, rotten flesh, crossbow (rare)

# Polar Bear
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Ice Plains, Ice Spikes, and Frozen Ocean Biomes.

Health: High (15 Hearts)
Appearance: Large, white bear with a thick coat. Cubs are smaller but look similar.

Custom behavior: Becomes aggressive if a player approaches its cubs. Polar Bears will attack Foxes if they stay near it for too long. Are immune to Powder Snow.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Raw Cod (Rare), Raw Salmon (Rare)

# Spider
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: All Biomes Except Mush Fields and Deep Dark, Spawns in Caves, Spawns in low-light levels.

Health: Medium (8 Hearts)
Appearance: Large black arachnid with eight legs and red eyes. The spider has 2 Spawning Varients:
- Spider (Normal Spider)
- Spider Jocket (Spawns with a Skeleton Riding it, this is Rare)

Custom behavior: Climbs walls and jumps at players. Neutral in daylight but hostile in the dark. Will remain Hostile if they enter a light area from a dark one. Spiders' can climb walls and on the cleiling. Spiders' are Immune to Poison Damage. Spiders flip onto their Backs when dying.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: String, Spider Eye

# Wolf
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Forests, Taigas

Health: Low-Medium (When Wild has 4 Hearts, 10 when Tamed)
Appearance: Gray, four-legged canine with a bushy tail.

Custom behavior: Becomes hostile if attacked. Tamed wolves follow and defend players. Can be Tamed with Bones. Wolves scare off Skeletons. Killer Rabbits will go out of their way to attack Wolves.
Can be bred: True. Breeds with any meat.
Drops when killed: None

# Zombified Piglin
Type: Neutral
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Nether

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: Undead pig-like humanoid with a golden sword.

Custom behavior: Attacks in groups when provoked but is neutral otherwise. Zombified Piglins will try to destroy any turtle eggs they see. Will avoid Magma Blocks. Will not retreat from Zoglins. Zombified Piglins are not Distracted by gold, and cannot barter. Damaged by Instant Healing Potions. Healed by Instant Damage Potions. Unable to Swim, will not drown.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Rotten Flesh, Gold Nuggets, Gold Ingot (Rare), Golden Sword (Rare)

# Blaze
Type: Aggressive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Nether fortresses

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: Floating, fiery creature with long, flaming sticks and a glowing core. Moves quickly through the air and can shoot fireballs.

Custom behavior: Attacks players with fireballs from a distance. Blazes are immune to damage from fire and lava, and fly, although when not attacking they stay on the ground or sink down slowly through the air. Blazes attempt to swim upward in lava or water. Blazes are also hurt by snowballs.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Blaze rod

# Bogged
Type: Aggressive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Swamps, bog biomes

Health: Medium (8 hearts)
Appearance: Sluggish, greenish creature with a mossy exterior, often camouflaged in the swamp environment. "Boggeds" behave very similarly to skeletons. They will attack nearby players by shooting arrows tipped with poison at them. Notably, Boggeds are much slower to reload their bows than normal skeletons

Custom behavior: Attack nearby players by shooting arrows tipped with poison at them
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: It may drop bones, arrows, arrows of poison, damaged bow

# Breeze
Type: Aggressive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Breezes spawn from trial spawners surrounded by chiseled tuff in trial chambers. They spawn specifically from trial spawners that have a rotating, diagonally-oriented breeze inside them, and will stop spawning when the trial is complete.

Health: High (15 hearts)
Appearance: Breezes are similar to that of a Blaze. They have a head that is bright purple on top and a dark blue on the bottom with two eyes that have yellow scleras, large white bushy eyebrows that resemble clouds and gives the appearance of it being angry. Underneath the head are three rods that are similar to a Blaze's Rods. Said rods are surrounded by a bunch of lines that resemble a wind tunnel or a tornado. The Breeze is a possible windier cousin of the Blaze. A Breeze also hovers slightly above the ground, similar to a Blaze.

Custom behavior: Breezes are immune to damage from projectiles and able to repel them back. They are also immune to fall damage, much like cats. They leap all around to attack players and iron golems nearby, firing wind charges that burst to switch some redstone components and knock entities up and back. The knockback and radius are larger than that of a player-crafted wind charge, allowing it to launch itself around the room it's in.
Drops when killed: Breeze rods

# Creeper
Type: Aggressive
Rarity: Common
Spawn: Overworld, especially in dark areas

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: Green and cubiculal humanoid with a sad face. Known for its iconic explosion and stealthy movement.

Custom behavior: Sneaks up on players and explodes when close. Using a flint and steel or fire charge‌ on a creeper forces an explosion.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Gunpowder, rare music disc. creeper head, if killed by a charged creeper

# Elder Guardian
Type: Aggressive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Ocean monuments (one per monument)

Health: High
Appearance: Large, spiky fish with three eyes and a formidable presence. Covered in barnacles and emits a dark aura.

Custom behavior: Shoots laser beams and inflicts mining fatigue on players.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Prismarine shards, prismarine crystals, wet sponge, raw cod

# Endermite
Type: Aggressive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: End, after the player uses an Ender Pearl or a rare chance of spawning after an enderman teleports

Health: Low
Appearance: Small, purple, insect-like creature that resembles a miniature Enderman. Agile and quick. 

Custom behavior: Attacks players nearby. Endermites attack iron golems and enderman. Endermites are suffocated by the soul sand when stepped on.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: None.

# Ender Dragon
Type: Aggressive
Rarity: Extremely Rare
Spawn: End dimension, specifically at the End pillars platform within the End biome.

Health: Very High (100 hearts)
Appearance: A massive, dark-scaled dragon with purple eyes and a pair of large, bat-like wings. Its body consists of distinct segments: head, neck, wings, body, and tail.

Custom behavior: Attacks players with fireballs and swoops down for melee attacks. It can recover hearts using the ender crystal around the main ender island. If a crystal is destroyed while the dragon is connected to them, the dragon will receive explosive damage.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Custom behavior: The Ender Dragon can fly and shoot explosive fireballs that deal a lot of damage. It will actively guard the End dimension and regenerate health through nearby End crystals. When defeated, it triggers the endgame event and opens up the gateway for players.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: An End gateway portal to the outer islands and an Ender Dragon egg appears atop the central portal after the first defeat.

# Evoker
Type: Aggressive
Rarity: Rare
Spawn: Woodland Mansions, Raids in the Overworld.

Health: Medium (12 hearts)
Appearance: A gray-skinned humanoid Illager wearing a dark green robe with gold trimming. It has a sinister expression and wields magical powers.

Custom behavior: The Evoker uses magic attacks, summoning vexes to attack players or "fang attacks" that shoot up from the ground in a nearby area. They do not attack other Illagers and can be integral in raids.
Can be bred: False
Drops when killed: Totem of Undying (guaranteed), emeralds, and an ominous banner if they are in a raid.

# Ghast
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Nether, floating in large open spaces (typically near lava lakes).

Health: Medium (5 hearts).
Appearance: A large, floating, ghost-like creature with white skin and a square-shaped body. The Ghast has long dangling tentacles at its bottom and often has a crying face with tears flowing down its cheeks. It hovers in the air at relatively high altitudes.

Custom behavior: Ghasts fire explosive fireballs from a distance towards players. They float and fly away quickly when hit or approached. If a person returns the fireball by striking it, the mob can be killed by its own projectile.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Ghast tears, gunpowder.

# Guardian
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Ocean Monuments, Deep Ocean.

Health: Medium (15 hearts)
Appearance: A pufferfish-like sea creature with a spiny, blue-green body and a single central eye. The Guardian has spikes that extend and retract periodically.

Custom behavior: Guardians swim underwater and attack any intruders (primarily players or squid) using a long-range laser beam. When spines are extended, melee attackers receive damage in return. They guard Ocean Monuments alongside their more powerful variant, the Elder Guardian.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Prismarine shards, prismarine crystals and raw cow

# Hoglin
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Crimson Forest found in the Nether.

Health: High.
Appearance: A massive pig-like creature with light brown, almost pinkish flesh and very large tusks protruding from its head. Hoglins have bulky frames and thick legs, suited for the harsh environment of the Nether. Baby versions are smaller but still aggressive.

Custom behavior: Hoglins attack humans and other entities within reach using a charging headbutt attack. When engaged, certain mobs like Piglins can hunt them for food, and they also fear Warped Fungus, often preferring to avoid it.
Can be bred: True. Breeding two Hoglins requires feeding them Crimson Fungus.
Drops when killed: Raw porkchop, leather.

# Slime
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Swamp biomes during the night or in specific underground slime chunks.

Health: Varies by size (Large: Medium (8 hearts), Medium: Low (4 hearts), Small: Low (0.5 hearts)).
Appearance: Large, cube-shaped, greenish-jelly-like creatures. Slimes have simple eyes and mouths on an otherwise translucent body and can vary in size from large blocks to tiny, lesser-damage versions.

Custom behavior: Slimes move by hopping towards their target. When a large or medium slime is hit, it splits into smaller versions until only the smallest ones are left, which will eventually be harmless. Slimes are able to swim and aren’t harmed by water.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Slimeballs (from smaller ones).

# Skeleton
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Overworld at night or in dark areas such as caves.

Health: Medium (10 hearts).
Appearance: A humanoid skeletal figure armed with a bow. Skeletons have bare bones exposed, white or grayish in appearance, with no visible armor unless equipped through spawn conditions or drops.

Custom behavior: Skeletons shoot arrows from afar using their bows, attempting to keep a significant distance away from their target. They will retreat into shady areas or water during daylight to avoid burning. Special variants include Strays, found in snowy biomes.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Bones, arrows, occasionally bows or armor (if held by the skeleton).

# Silverfish
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Strongholds, but also concealed inside infested stone blocks.

Health: Low.
Appearance: Small, thin, and silver-colored, these insect-like creatures resemble slithering bugs. They have jagged limbs and a segmented body that allows them to creep through cracks in walls or blocks.

Custom behavior: Silverfish hide inside infested stone blocks and spawn when the block is broken. They swarm attackers in groups and may retreat into nearby stone blocks if not instantly killed. They can also call other Silverfish nearby when damaged.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Nothing.

# Shulker
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: End cities in the End dimension.

Health: High (15 hearts).
Appearance: A purple, block-like creature that hides inside a shell resembling purpur blocks. When closed, they are indistinguishable from other blocks. When open, a small head peeks out, shooting projectiles at invaders.

Custom behavior: Shulkers protect End cities by shooting homing projectiles that inflict Levitation, causing humans to float upward and take fall damage when the effect ends. Shulkers can teleport to nearby surfaces when damaged, and they remain in hiding unless provoked or disturbed.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Shulker shells.

# Ravager
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: During Raids in villages (as the raid progresses into higher waves).

Health: Very high (50 hearts)
Appearance: A massive grey, bull-like beast with horns and deep menacing eyes. It is heavily armored and has a broad snout and bulky frame, giving it immense strength.

Custom behavior: Ravagers charge toward targets, using headbutt attacks that cause knockback and significant damage to humans and villagers. They can also trample crops, destroy leaves, and break certain blocks as they move, making them especially destructive in raids.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Saddles.

# Pillager
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Pillager Outposts, Raids, patrols in the Overworld.

Health: Medium (12 hearts).
Appearance: A gray-skinned Illager with stern features, donned in dark clothing and a brown belt around its midsection. It wields a crossbow, which it uses to attack from a distance.

Custom behavior: Pillagers attack humans and villagers during raids, using crossbows to shoot from a distance. They can also spawn in patrol groups roaming the Overworld's plains. In raids, they participate alongside other raiding mobs.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Crossbow and arrows, sometimes emeralds.

# Piglin Brute
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Bastion Remnants in the Nether.

Health: High.
Appearance: A more bulky and muscular version of the Piglin, with black armor adorning their torso. They carry a golden axe and wear darker-colored clothing compared to regular Piglins.

Custom behavior: Piglin Brutes are stronger, more hostile versions of Piglins. Unlike regular Piglins, they do not barter or run from nearby Zombified Piglins, and they attack all intruders fiercely on sight without hesitation.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Golden axe.

Name: Phantom
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Nighttime if the human haven't slept for more than three consecutive nights in the Overworld.

Health: Medium (10 hearts).
Appearance: A dark, bat-like flying creature with glowing green eyes and ragged, translucent wings. Phantoms have a ghostly appearance, giving them an eerie presence when flying in the night sky.

Custom behavior: Phantoms spawn in packs and dive-bomb humans from the sky, attempting to deal damage from above. They are deterred by cats and burn in daylight, much like other undead mobs.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Phantom membrane.

# Magma Cube
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Nether, especially in Nether Wastes and Basalt Deltas.

Health: Varies by size (Large: High (8 hearts), Medium: Medium (4 hearts), Small: Low (0.5 hearts)).
Appearance: Cubic, gelatinous creatures with a black and fiery-orange appearance. Magma Cubes are made up of lava-like innards that appear to glow and shimmer. They can vary in size, from large blocks to tiny versions, similarly to Slimes.

Custom behavior: Magma Cubes move by hopping toward targets. When hit, large and medium variants split into smaller cubes until they are reduced to the smallest size, which are relatively harmless in damage. They can jump very high and move slightly faster than slimes on land.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Magma cream (from smaller ones).

# Husk
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Deserts at night or in low light conditions.

Health: Medium (10 hearts).
Appearance: A zombie-type mob with dried, desaturated skin and tattered clothes. Unlike standard zombies, they appear taller and have a distinct sandy coloring on their body, blending into the desert surroundings.

Custom behavior: Husks deal the Hunger status effect when they hit humans, causing their hunger bar to deplete faster. They do not burn in sunlight, unlike regular zombies, making them more dangerous in desert biomes during the day.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Rotten flesh.

# Zombie Villager
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Overworld like regular zombies, or transformed from villagers via zombie attacks.

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: A villager with decayed green skin and ragged clothing, similar to a zombie. Though zombified, they still retain the facial features and profession-based garb of their original, pre-zombie villager profession.

Custom behavior: Zombie Villagers behave like zombies, attacking humans and other entities they come across. However, they can be cured by using a splash potion of Weakness and a golden apple, returning them to their original villager state. They will attack humans until cured or killed.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Rotten flesh, occasionally iron ingots or tools (like regular zombies).

# Zombie
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Common.
Spawn: Overworld at night or in dark areas such as caves.

Health: Medium (10 hearts)
Appearance: A humanoid creature with decayed green skin, sunken eyes, and tattered clothes. Zombies move slowly and groan loudly while pursuing their targets.

Custom behavior: Zombies will attack humans and villagers alike by slowly walking toward them and dealing melee damage. They burn in sunlight and are hostile toward villagers, especially targeting babies. Zombies can also summon help (other nearby zombies) if they find a human.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Rotten flesh, sometimes iron ingots, armor, or tools.

# Zoglin
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Transformed from a Hoglin if brought to the Overworld.

Health: High (20 hearts).
Appearance: Zoglins are decayed, zombified versions of the Hoglin, with grayer skin, a missing eye, and patches of exposed bone. They appear more grotesque and aggressive than their Nether counterparts.

Custom behavior: Zoglins will attack almost any entity nearby, including humans, animals, and villagers. Unlike Hoglins, they cannot be bred or fed and will try to attack almost everything on sight, making them a dangerous, mindless force.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Rotten flesh.

# Wither Skeleton
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Nether Fortresses within the Nether.

Health: Medium (10 hearts).
Appearance: Taller, darker versions of the regular skeleton, with completely black bones and carrying stone swords. They have a slightly more menacing appearance with their tall figure and shadowy form.

Custom behavior: Wither Skeletons attack with their stone swords, inflicting the Wither effect on humans, which slowly drains health. Unlike normal skeletons, they do not use bows and instead prefer melee attacks. They are immune to fire and lava, making them extremely dangerous in Nether Fortresses.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Bones, coal, stone swords, with a rare chance to drop Wither Skeleton skulls.

# Wither
Type: Aggressive (Boss).
Rarity: Extremely Rare.
Spawn: Summoned by players using soul sand/soul soil blocks and 3 Wither Skeleton skulls.

Health: Extremely High (150 hearts).
Appearance: A floating, black, skeletal creature with three heads. The central head remains passive but attacks by shooting explosive Wither skulls from its sides. The Wither’s body cracks and flashes as it takes damage.

Custom behavior: The Wither attacks anything it perceives as a threat, shooting Wither skulls that cause explosions and inflict the Wither effect. Upon reaching half health, the Wither becomes immune to arrow damage and summons a barrier to protect itself, starting to act closer to any entity.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Nether Star.

# Witch
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Swamp huts (known as Witch Huts), nighttime in swamps, or extremely rarely during village raids as part of higher waves.

Health: Medium (13 hearts).
Appearance: Humanoid figure with gray skin, wearing a purple robe and a pointed black witch hat. Their nose twitches when idle, giving them a distinctive, somewhat mischievous appearance.

Custom behavior: Witches throw harmful splash potions (poison, slowness, harm) at enemies from a distance. They also heal themselves using health potions. They are largely hostile and will often be found alone or sporadically in swamps or as part of raids.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Glass bottles, various potions, redstone, glowstone dust, gunpowder, sugar, sticks or spider eyes.

# Warden
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Extremely Rare.
Spawn: Deep Dark biome within the Overworld, specifically from the ground when activated by nearby Sculk Shriekers.

Health: Extremely High (250 hearts).
Appearance: A towering, muscular figure, covered in dark bluish Sculk with glowing heart-like patterns in its chest. The Warden has no discernible eyes, relying on its heightened sense of hearing for navigation and attacks.

Custom behavior: Wardens are blind but possess exceptional hearing and sense nearby vibrations, especially sounds made by walking, dropping items, or attacking. When sufficiently provoked, they unleash a powerful sonic blast attack. If unaware of nearby targets, they will return underground. Things like block sounds are his worst weakness, for example, wool.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Drops a single sculk catalyst upon death.

# Vindicator
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Woodland Mansions; also during Raids in Villages in the Overworld.

Health: Medium (12 hearts)
Appearance: A pale, gray-skinned Illager with an angry, stern facial expression, wearing a dark purple coat. Vindicators wield iron axes, which they use for melee attacks.

Custom behavior: Vindicators will charge directly at their target with their iron axe raised, dealing a substantial amount of melee damage. During Raids, they contribute to the raid waves, and with the player's intervention, a Vindicator can be renamed as "Johnny," leading it to attack all mobs, excluding other Illagers.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Iron axes, emeralds (sometimes) and a ominous banner if they are in a raid.

# Vex
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Summoned by Evokers during Raids or in Woodland Mansions.

Health: Low.
Appearance: Small, ghostly humanoid creatures with pale blue skin, white clothing, and spectral wings. They wield small iron swords and can fly, phasing through solid blocks with ease.

Custom behavior: Vexes are summoned by Evokers during combat and will chase and relentlessly attack their target, ignoring terrain by flying and passing through blocks. They can disappear after a short time or once the Evoker that summoned them has been killed.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Iron sword.

# Stray
Type: Aggressive.
Rarity: Rare.
Spawn: Snowy biomes (Ice Plains, Ice Spikes, Frozen Rivers) during the night or in dark areas.

Health: Medium (10 hearts).
Appearance: A skeleton variant dressed in rugged, frozen clothing. It has a blue-tinted texture to its bones and tattered rags, with its bones giving off a frosty aura.

Custom behavior: Strays shoot tipped arrows that apply the Slowness effect, reducing the speed of their targets. They avoid sunlight, much like other undead mobs, by seeking shelter or water during the day.
Can be bred: False.
Drops when killed: Bones, arrows (sometimes tipped arrows of Slowness), bows.
